newsitem.title: USA: Northwestern Steel to shut plant for 10 days.
newsitem.headline: Northwestern Steel to shut plant for 10 days.

text.p: Northwestern Steel & Wire Co said Thursday it will not operate its structural plant in Houston between January 17 and January 26.
In a prepared statement, the company said order backlogs have decreased in recent weeks and inventory levels are adequate. The plant will ungergo routine maintenance work during the shutdown.
Company officials were unavailable to provide further details.
Northwestern Steel & Wire makes steel components. Its shares closed down 1/4 Thursday to close at 4-3/4.
